```
├── SEO-PLAN.md                  # SEO improvement plan & tracking
└── octoprint_plugin_lists/      # OctoPrint plugin listing data
```

### Key Rule: Edit `blog/`, NOT `obico-server/website/blog/`

The Docusaurus blog directory (`obico-server/website/blog/`) is a **transient copy**. It gets wiped and rebuilt from the top-level `blog/` directory on every release. Always edit files in `blog/` at the repo root.

Same applies to translations: edit `docusaurus-i18n/`, not `obico-server/website/i18n/`.

## Development

### Local Build (for testing)

```bash
# Copy source files into Docusaurus project (mimics release.sh)
cd obico-server/website
rm -f blog/* && cp ../../blog/* blog/
rm -rf i18n/* && cp -r ../../docusaurus-i18n/* i18n/

# Build
npm install && npm run build
```

### Dev Server

```bash
cd obico-server/website
npm start
```

Note: The dev server only serves the default locale. For full i18n testing, use `npm run build` + `npm run serve`.

JusPrin Privacy Policy

JusPrin is a desktop app. What you make in it stays on your computer unless you use a feature that needs the internet, and the principles below say how we treat what leaves it.

Our principles

  1. Your work is yours. Your models, projects and chats belong to you.
  2. We collect only what a feature needs. When you use an online feature, we collect only what that feature needs to work.
  3. We share only to do what you asked. We share your information with another company only when that is needed to do what you asked, such as the AI provider that writes a reply or the company that processes your payment. They may use it only for that purpose. Any other sharing needs your explicit permission first.
  4. No new uses without asking. We won't use your information for a purpose this policy doesn't describe, such as training AI models, unless you opt in.
  5. We don't sell your information or use it for advertising.
  6. Printer secrets stay on your computer. Printer access codes, passwords and print-host keys are never sent to us or to AI providers.
  7. You stay in control. You can see, export or delete your information, and close your account, at any time.
  8. No surprises. We tell you before an important change to this policy takes effect.

Who we are

TSD Technology, LLC ("we", "us") makes JusPrin and runs JusPrin accounts. JusPrin accounts are separate from Obico accounts, and this policy covers JusPrin only. You can reach us about privacy at jusprin-support@obico.io.

What we collect

  • Your account: your email address, and basic profile details from the sign-in method you choose.
  • What you send to the AI assistant: your messages and attachments, and the parts of your open project the assistant needs to help you, such as settings, object details and pictures of the build plate.
  • What you choose to send us: for example print reports or problem reports.
  • Usage needed to run your account: for example the credits you use.
  • Payments: handled by our payment processor. We don't see your full card number.

You can slice and print without an account. If you add your own API key for an AI provider, the app sends your chats straight from your computer to that provider. We don't receive them, and that provider's terms and privacy policy apply.

Other services the app talks to

  • Update checks. The app checks for new versions, sending only basic technical details such as its version number. You can turn this off.
  • Printer makers' services. If you connect a printer through its maker's online service or software, that maker's privacy policy covers that connection.
  • Public problem reports. If you choose to report a problem publicly, for example as a GitHub issue, the app shows you the text first. Nothing is posted until you submit it.

How long we keep it

We keep your information only as long as we need it to provide the service, or as long as the law requires. When you delete your account, we delete your information within 30 days, except records the law requires us to keep. Copies in our backups are deleted as those backups expire.

Your rights

You can ask us to show, correct, export or delete your information by writing to jusprin-support@obico.io.

Children

JusPrin accounts are not meant for children under 13, or under the minimum age for agreeing to online services in their country if that is higher. If you believe a child has given us information, write to us and we will delete it.

International transfers

We and the companies we work with may process information in other countries.

Changes to this policy

We post changes at https://www.obico.io/jusprin-privacy.html, and we tell you in the app or by email before an important change takes effect.

See also the JusPrin Terms of Service.

Last updated: 9 November 2026.

JusPrin Terms of Service

These terms cover JusPrin's online services: accounts, the AI assistant through a JusPrin account, credits and plans, and anything you send us. They don't limit your rights to the app under its open-source license.

1. Agreeing to these terms

By creating a JusPrin account or using our online services, you agree to these terms and to the Privacy Policy. If you use JusPrin for a business, you agree on its behalf. You must be at least 13, or the minimum age for agreeing to online services in your country if that is higher. If you are under 18, you need a parent's or guardian's permission.

2. The app and its license

JusPrin is free, open-source software based on OrcaSlicer, released under the GNU Affero General Public License version 3. That license, not these terms, governs copying, changing and sharing the app's code.

3. Your account

Give us accurate information and keep your sign-in to yourself. You are responsible for what happens under your account. Tell us at jusprin-support@obico.io if you think someone else has used it.

4. The AI assistant

The AI assistant can make mistakes. Check what it suggests or changes before you print. You decide what to print, and you are responsible for your printer, what it makes, and watching over it while it runs. Don't rely on the assistant for anything where a mistake could hurt someone. Replies come from AI models made by other companies, so the assistant may sometimes be slow, unavailable or different from before.

5. Credits and plans

Using the AI assistant through a JusPrin account may use credits. What credits cost, what each plan includes, and when credits expire are shown on our pricing page. We tell you before a price change affects a plan you pay for. Credits have no cash value and can't be sold or transferred.

6. Your content

Your models, projects, messages and anything else you send stay yours. You let us store and process them, and pass them to the companies we work with, only as needed to provide the service you asked for. Any other use needs your permission, as the Privacy Policy says. Only send things you have the right to share.

7. Fair use

Don't use the service to break the law or to harm others. Don't try to get around credit limits, share or resell access, or break into or overload our servers.

8. Other companies' services

Printers, print hosts, printer makers' online services and AI providers belong to other companies. Their own terms apply, and we are not responsible for them.

9. Ending your account

You can stop using the service and close your account at any time. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, with notice where we reasonably can.

10. Disclaimers and limits on liability

The service is provided "as is". To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for failed prints, wasted material, damage to printers or property, or indirect losses. Nothing here limits rights you have under consumer law that can't be waived.

11. Changes to these terms

We post changes at https://www.obico.io/jusprin-terms.html, and we tell you in the app or by email before an important change takes effect.

12. Law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, United States.
